directional_symmetry: ASSUMPTION: same total OD in both directions; no observed directional profile
weekly_allocation: ASSUMPTION: desired bookings are equally distributed across available dated itineraries; no calibrated daily peaks
demand_unit: total air endpoint OD per week per direction; independent of project seats
fare_unit: net realised revenue per one-way journey, RUB ex recoverable VAT; scenario, not quote
annualisation: 52 identical weeks is only annual-equivalent run rate, never 2027 forecast

benchmark.scenario_normalisation: 47000/(2*52)=451.9 flown segments/week/direction IF total both directions and symmetric; not final OD and not winter demand
benchmark.use: scale check for broad stress probes, not route demand estimation

reference_basket.note: UFA public list ex VAT; illustrative one-turn service basket, not signed all-airport contract; terms can replace/double some items. Daily check, towing, GPU, fluids, catering and overnight parking not fully covered; maintenance hourly reserve is scenario.

observed: 100 RW SSJ seats from airline fleet page
published calendar and clock times in sources.json
unknown: capture response and incumbent RW migration
available fleet, spare coverage, base costs, airport windows
